text:
natalie: FYI Announcement  We are opening a constrained preview for a new inference-optimised SKU, VegaX-Edge, in eu-central (Frankfurt) and us-east-3 (Ashburn). Goal: very low tail latency for regional LLM endpoints and edge-adjacent routing. Preview reservations open 2026-07-12 05:00 UTC via Console + API. :satellite:
eric: VegaX-Edge = new hardware or tuned variant? any headline perf?
jo: It's a tuned variant of our VegaX line with trimmed FP working sets and an optimized interconnect for small-batch inference. Early numbers: p50 ~28ms, p95 ~95ms on 4k context int8 with affinity enabled (2-unit reservation). We'll publish detailed bench later this week.
natalie: SLA: 99.9% reserved availability during preview. Burst policy: short bursts allowed up to 10% of pool for 3-minute windows, 3x/day. Bursts are metered while we calibrate.
infra-bot: Planned fleet sizes: eu-central = 48 units (12 clusters), us-east-3 = 44 units (11 clusters). Per-org preview cap: 10 units.
eric: Any migration path for existing VegaX customers?
natalie: Yes  we will offer a conversion pathway for active VegaX reserved customers: prorated credits + 45-day overlap. Submit migration interest here: https://intra.redwood.io/dedicated/migrate-vega (internal).
jo: Recommended config: enable per-request affinity and KV prefix caching for best tail behavior. For cost-sensitive workloads we recommend int8 qpack; int4 if model validated.
partners: How do partners reserve for demos / PoCs?
natalie: For partner demos request a preview slot via Console > Dedicated > Preview requests or ping me. We'll hold demo quota for partners and CS.
billing: Preview reservations use sku vegax-edge.preview and are not billed until conversion or GA opt-in. Conversion offers include prorated credits for active VegaX commitments within 45 days. For custom quotes contact billing@redwood.com.
jo: API example (internal):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/dedicated/reservations \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"region":"eu-central","gpu_type":"vegax-edge","units":2,"term_months":6}'
```
sre: Note on tail-latency: avoid auto-batching >64 tokens for p95-sensitive paths. We'll publish a tuning playbook and a perf dashboard link in #eng when ready.
infra-bot: Rollout plan: canary -> 20% -> 60% -> GA. Canary starts 2026-07-12 05:00 UTC. Monitoring hooks and extra trace sampling enabled for first 72h.
eric: Quota increase turnaround?
natalie: Preview quota requests: Console > Support > Dedicated quotas; expect 24-72h turnaround.
natalie: I'll host a 30m office hours session in #dedicated tomorrow 16:00 CEST to walk through reservation flow, migration options, and perf tuning. Ping me to reserve a slot. :calendar:
